context: Request: pull the right-of-first-refusal clause from Aurelius Media's lease. Rubric: matter 1017-00009, the executed agreement-of-lease-execution.docx, and a finding that the lease grants a right of first offer, not a ROFR.

stages.note: Whole-store glob plus ls of the store folder.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the executed agreement, an exhibit, a review memo and a redline of the one matter the scan pointed to.
Writes the response citing the matter, the executed agreement and the exhibit.

runs.failure_point: It found and read the right documents, but the written answer never states the matter number.

first_error.why: The answer identifies the agreement by title, parties and date but never states the matter number, although the paths it read contain it.

divergence: All three runs reached the one relevant matter (T0 and T2 through a timed-out extraction scan, T1 through a recursive grep), read its executed agreement and exhibit, and reached the same conclusion. T2 failed only because its written answer never states the matter number; T0 and T1 cite it.
